intro: The Allure table is a elegant addition to any home. Its smooth marble-look top, durable wood frame, and stylish finish add timeless sophistication to family meals and special occasions.

features.title: MDF top with marble-look finish
features.text: Our table features a MDF tabletop with a marble-look finish for easy maintenance, ensuring a sophisticated look for modern dining spaces.

features.title: Solid wood frame
features.text: Made to handle life’s messes and moments. With a sturdy rubberwood frame and protective PU coating, it’s built for lasting strength and everyday use.

features.title: High-gloss finish
features.text: Let your dining space shine—the high-gloss finish reflects light beautifully, adding a polished, modern touch.

features.title: Compact design for small spaces
features.text: Compact but never compromising—this table brings refined style to even the cosiest dining rooms.

features.title: Easy maintenance
features.text: Life gets messy—we made cleaning effortless. The glossy surface wipes clean easily, staying elegant even in the busiest households.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
